newsitem.title: INDIA: India house approves budget spending proposals.
newsitem.headline: India house approves budget spending proposals.

text.p: The lower house of the Indian parliament, the Lok Sabha, on Tuesday approved spending proposals of all the federal ministries, forming part of the package of budgetary for 1997/98 (April-March), officials said.

The house approved the "demands for grants" for all ministries without debate after briefly discussing demands for four government departments, coal, non-conventional energy sources, power and atomic energy, they said.

Parliament is scheduled to take up on Wednesday the Finance Bill for 1997/98 containing proposals for changes in taxes and customs duties. A vote on the Finance Bill is expected by the end of the week.
